method.timing: Separate unprofiled pass: at least 500ms/32 calls warmup, 9 samples, 20ms target batches; full rows verified outside clocks.
method.cpu: V8 inspector, 500us interval; setup/warmup/validation excluded. Recursive inclusive time is counted once per function per stack.
method.heap: Separate sampled JS heap pass, 32768-byte sampling, including objects collected by minor/major GC. Wasm GC allocations may be absent; not a total-allocation or leak measurement.
method.calls: Separate untimed facade instance wraps native exports to count JS-to-Wasm calls. No wrappers in timing/CPU/heap passes.
method.caveat: Profiled throughput is not speed evidence. Warmup is longer than benchmark suite v1 and may change JIT tiering. No concurrent builds/tests/profilers.
